svg.title: code-dope 3-Tier Architecture and Security Trust Boundary
svg.desc: Diagram of the three tiers in code-dope (Level 1 Sandbox Helpers, Level 2 Adapters and Policy, Level 3 Worker and QuickJS-WASM Executor) separated from host tools and credentials by a JSON-only bridge and fail-closed withPolicy gate.
